## Summary table

::: {#tbl-summary .cell tbl-cap='Summary statistics per group.' execution_count=2}

``` {.python .cell-code}
summary = data.groupby("group")["value"].agg(["mean", "std", "count"]).round(2)
Markdown(summary.to_markdown())
```

## Distribution

::: {.cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
for name, grp in data.groupby("group"):
    ax.hist(grp["value"], bins=15, alpha=0.6, label=name)
ax.legend()
plt.show()
```
